names.note: Name page 15021 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Николай (Прозоров), иерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line giving only the genitive «Николая» beside a second name. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE, and a Cyrillic grep for «Прозоров» over every `saint.json` returned nothing — the many bare «Николай» folders are a fold this form stays clear of.

death.note: The line closes «(1930)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere, and no life page behind his name.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 8 августа ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Николая и Сергия пресвитеров (1930).»

attestations.note: First of the two names in the day's eighth entry, and an enumerated pair is two folders. THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind either name. The line says «пресвитеров» and name page 15021 «иерей», priest, so `presbyter` and the office `Priest` are both the source's own words. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar's twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries. No folder held him: `ls -d saints/*prozorov*` was empty. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
